description: The CROSSBOW project publishes SCADA measurements at Croatia’s Konjsko substation around a curtailment at the Pometeno Brno wind plant. Zenodo provides twenty-four CSV files under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. The description names active and reactive power and voltage at 110, 220 and 400 kV buses, plus a line linking the plant to the substation, before, during and after the event. Coverage is the Konjsko substation and its connecting wind plant. These observations can calibrate curtailment and voltage-response simulations. A related CROSSBOW release supplies simulated random-day limitations for algorithm testing; this record is the measured-event counterpart. A limitation is that the public page does not state sensor calibration, exact event date, sample interval or completeness. One activation cannot establish performance across seasons or all grid states. The files were not downloaded and no waveform or energy balance was checked.
